summary: GoAccess is a web log analyser designed to parse server access logs and present them through an interactive terminal interface. It processes traffic data in real time, allowing administrators to inspect visitor metrics directly from a command-line environment. The software is written in C and distributed under the GPL-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It suits systems administrators and developers who prefer managing infrastructure via the terminal and need lightweight, immediate log analysis without heavy web dashboards.
watchOut: The terminal-based interface lacks the advanced filtering and long-term historical querying capabilities found in dedicated modern web analytics platforms. Maintenance activity appears to be slowing down, which may impact future compatibility or bug fixes.
deployNotes: As a compiled C utility, it typically requires access to local log files and persistent storage if you wish to retain historical processed data. You will generally need to manage log rotation and configure your own terminal access or web-based terminal wrappers if remote viewing is required.
